summary: The delivery lead wants people notified when a work order is ready for review, so tickets don't sit unreviewed. The notification should go out when the work order workflow writes a work order.
Requested by the team lead; internal documentation work, no customer involvement.

acceptance_criteria: When a work order is written, the right people are notified that it is ready for review.
The notification links to the ticket.
Tickets sent back for more detail do not send the notification.

codebase.relevance: Writes the work order; where the notification would be triggered.

getting_started: Read the files listed under the codebase section first.
